typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		ENTITY_ID as integer,
		modif_dateNoTime as date,
		Currency_Pair as string,
		TRADER_NAME as string,
		Load_Date as timestamp,
		BOOK_NAME as string,
		TRADE_DATE_TIME as timestamp,
		TRADE_STATUS as string,
		PRODUCT_TYPE as string,
		MODIF_DATE as timestamp,
		Currency as string,
		SALES_PERSON as string,
		Notional as integer,
		Cpty_ShortName as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource sink(input(
		ENTITY_ID as integer,
		modif_dateNoTime as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		Currency_Pair as string,
		TRADER_NAME as string,
		Load_Date as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		BOOK_NAME as string,
		TRADE_DATE_TIME as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		TRADE_STATUS as string,
		PRODUCT_TYPE as string,
		MODIF_DATE as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		Currency as string,
		SALES_PERSON as string,
		Notional as integer,
		Cpty_ShortName as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		ENTITY_ID,
		modif_dateNoTime,
		Currency_Pair,
		TRADER_NAME,
		Load_Date,
		BOOK_NAME,
		TRADE_DATE_TIME,
		TRADE_STATUS,
		PRODUCT_TYPE,
		MODIF_DATE,
		Currency,
		SALES_PERSON,
		Notional,
		Cpty_ShortName),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
